When you reach them, say something very close to this:

> “My Visa credit card ending in 4429 is stolen. I noticed it missing this morning. Please block it immediately and issue a replacement card. There are several charges from late last night and today that I don’t recognize; I want to dispute those as unauthorized.”

They will:
- Block the 4429 card
- Issue a replacement with a new number
- Start the fraud/dispute process

2) Prepare the transactions to dispute

- Go to **your Visa ending in 4429** → **Recent activity / Transactions**  
- Focus on **yesterday and today**  
- Make a quick list of anything you don’t recognize, with:
  - Date & time
  - Merchant name
  - Amount

You can tell the bank:

> “These are the transactions I’m disputing as unauthorized:  
> - [Date, Merchant, Amount]  
> - [Date, Merchant, Amount]  
> (…etc.)”

- **Open fraud/dispute cases** for each
- **Cancel any pending authorizations** tied to the stolen card
- Confirm **whether a temporary credit** will be posted while they investigate

- Remove the **Visa ending in 4429** from:
  - Apple Pay / Google Pay / Samsung Pay

- When the **replacement card** arrives, you can re-add it.
